question: What totality is being specified as the object here in relation to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: Reference is made to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
A totality called the all-field group is specified.
The relation is one of possession/specification.
inference: The all-field group belonging to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs is specified here.
plain_english: The all-field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
